name: Zenith Raging Tempest
name_jp: 究極レイジテンペスト
effects: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Zenith Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode: Strago], [Soul Break Gauge +250], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user. Grants [Attach Water 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Wind 2 with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Water/Wind.
